module.purpose: Provides the persistence layer for booking retrieval, updates, creation, cancellation, reassignment, authorization, scheduling, reporting, payment, calendar, workflow, and attendee operations through Prisma.
module.summary: This TypeScript repository implements the booking data-access contract with Prisma. It centralizes narrowly shaped booking queries for authorization, details, rescheduling, round-robin assignment, team availability, payments, calendar event construction, video settings, workflows, attendees, and reassignment. It also performs booking mutations, counts, duration aggregation, and transactional managed-event replacement while using shared Prisma select definitions and reporting instrumentation.
module.businessContext:
Supports appointment scheduling, rescheduling, team availability, payments, calendar synchronization, and managed-event reassignment.
Failure can prevent booking creation or cancellation, misreport availability, break authorization, or leave external meeting and workflow data inconsistent.

edgeCases.inputShape: UID or ID does not match a record
edgeCases.behavior: findUnique and findFirst methods return null; getFromRescheduleUid converts a missing result to null.

edgeCases.inputShape: UID does not match a record in findByUidIncludeEventTypeAndReferences
edgeCases.behavior: findUniqueOrThrow raises the Prisma not-found error.
The active-booking query omits the routing-form response constraint and getAllBookingsForRoundRobin returns all queried bookings.

edgeCases.inputShape: Routing response lacks the requested field
edgeCases.behavior: The filter accesses response[fieldId].value and can throw when the field is absent.

edgeCases.inputShape: Routing response and selected option IDs are arrays
edgeCases.behavior: A booking matches only when array lengths and every value at the corresponding index are equal.
Team booking methods execute count queries and return the sum of owner, attendee, and optionally managed-event counts.
Managed-event queries are skipped and managed bookings contribute zero or an empty array.
The booking update invokes createMany with an empty attendee data array and updates responses.

edgeCases.inputShape: paymentId is absent or falsy during managed-event creation
metadata, responses, or customInputs are null or undefined during managed-event creation
edgeCases.behavior: Those booking fields are passed as undefined rather than persisted values.
The duration query sums all accepted bookings matching event, date, and time bounds.

errorHandling.action: Propagates the synchronous filtering error to the caller.

assumptions.description: Prisma model fields, relations, enums, and select/include shapes match the imported Prisma schema.
Callers provide valid booking identifiers, dates, user data, and JSON-compatible metadata values.
The injected PrismaClient is initialized and available before repository methods are invoked.
The routedFromRoutingFormReponse value contains a response object when virtual queue filtering is requested.
The database supports PostgreSQL EXTRACT(EPOCH) duration aggregation and Prisma parameterized raw queries.
The optional transaction client is compatible with the Prisma booking operations used by reassignment methods.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A managed event reassignment succeeds only when cancellation and replacement booking creation both complete in one transaction.
moduleContractTests.then: the returned object contains both cancelledBooking and newBooking, and neither partial write is visible if either operation fails
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the transaction boundary across cancellation and replacement creation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An existing managed-event booking is cancelled with a reason and optional metadata.
moduleContractTests.then: the persisted booking has status BookingStatus.CANCELLED and the returned result contains id, uid, metadata, and status
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the cancellation state and returned projection.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A managed-event replacement booking is created with multiple attendees.
moduleContractTests.then: the returned booking includes the created attendees ordered by attendee id ascending
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the repository's deterministic attendee projection.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Round-robin bookings include virtual queue data with selected response values.
moduleContractTests.when: repository.getAllBookingsForRoundRobin({ users, eventTypeId, virtualQueuesData, includeNoShowInRRCalculation, rrTimestampBasis })
moduleContractTests.then: only bookings whose routing-form response matches the selected option value or ordered option array are returned
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards scalar and all-in array matching for virtual queues.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Accepted team bookings are requested with shouldReturnCount enabled.
moduleContractTests.then: the result is a number equal to collective owner bookings plus attendee bookings plus managed bookings when includeManagedEvents is true
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins count-mode aggregation and managed-event inclusion.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking status update omits optional cancellation and rescheduling fields.
moduleContractTests.then: only supplied status fields and updatedAt are changed
moduleContractTests.rationale: Prevents omitted optional fields from being overwritten.
